Strategic Action Framework

Key managerial directives for H2 implementation based on performance insights

Mitigation Plan & Training

De-risk Concentrated Operations: Anil Goyal manages over 40% of operations. Distribute incoming client lists across top mid-tier counsellors to reduce bottleneck risk.

Recovery Benchmark Training: Designate Mithesh Parmar as Recovery Lead to train lower yield desks on retrieving aged balances.

Tactical & Financial Framework

Incentivize Collections over Sales: Shift key commission tiers from raw booking values (Agreed Amount) to real cash values (Paid Collection) to prevent pipeline leakage.

Pipeline Tracking Audits: Institute strict weekly auditing for the ₹5,152,172 uncollected pool to prevent balances from converting to unrecoverable bad debts.
